name: MOFI Real Estate Investment Fund
source: MOFI Real Estate Investment Fund audited annual financial statements for the 10 months ended 31 December 2025 (Ernst and Young Nigeria, published on the NGX filing library), statement of cashflows, NGN thousands.

periodBasis.FY2025: 10 months ended 31 December 2025, audited. First and only annual period; the Fund began operations on 17 March 2025.

rows.label: Operating Cash Flow
rows.note: Net cash flows used in operating activities: profit before tax of 29,206,232 adjusted for interest income and credit loss expense, then loan issuance and repayments.

rows.label: Investing Cash Flow
rows.note: Interest received plus purchases of financial instruments less matured securities.

rows.label: Financing Cash Flow
rows.note: Unit holders' contribution of 250,000,000 less offer costs of 3,329,536 and dividends paid of 7,479,057.

notes: No capital expenditure line appears on the statement, so Capital Expenditure and Free Cash Flow are not carried.
Cash flow identity holds: (71,657,279) + (92,711,255) + 239,191,407 = 74,822,873, equal to the printed closing cash.
identityCheck: Operating + Investing + Financing = Net Change in Cash (74,822,873 NGN thousand), matching cash at 31 December 2025.
